# Jargalsaikhan Gansuld
:::

::: {.intro}
I'm a Data Science and Economics student at Central European University (CEU) in Vienna, where I blend rigorous quantitative methods with economic theory to explore real-world problems.

My passion lies at the intersection of data science, economics, and finance — using tools like machine learning, data analysis, sentiment analysis, correlation studies, and exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns in markets, consumer behavior, and economic trends. With hands-on experience from coursework and projects, I've built models to predict financial indicators, analyzed sentiment in economic news for investment insights, and conducted EDA on large datasets to reveal correlations between macroeconomic variables and asset prices.
:::
